version: EDG authored stdio management facade v1
provenance: Authored errno/strerror facade over owner-local BCL stream service. API behavior audited against pinned musl 1.2.6 src/stdio/perror.c; no musl implementation copied.
scope: perror resolves owner/TLS errno and writes raw bytes under the stream lock without changing orientation or captured encoding. Other management APIs are strict BCL imports.
